dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is there any furniture in the room?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðɛr ˈɛni ˈfɜːrnɪtʃər ɪn ðə ˈruːm?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. There's a bed, a desk, a closet and a small fridge.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðɛrz ə ˈbɛd, ə ˈdɛsk, ə ˈklɑːzɪt ənd ə ˈsmɔːl ˈfrɪdʒ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! Is it OK if I cook in the room?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ ɪf aɪ ˈkʊk ɪn ðə ˈruːm?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sorry, no. But you can use the microwave downstairs.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, ˈnoʊ. bʌt juː kən ˈjuːz ðə ˈmaɪkrəweɪv ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Is there a washing machine, too?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ɪz ðɛr ə ˈwɑːʃɪŋ məˌʃiːn, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, there are two. They're next to the stairs.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðɛr ər ˈtuː. ðɛr ˈnɛkst tə ðə ˈstɛrz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is it OK if I wash my clothes at night?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ ɪf aɪ ˈwɑːʃ maɪ ˈkloʊðz ət ˈnaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sure, but not after ten o'clock, please.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr, bʌt ˈnɑːt ˈæftər ˈtɛn əˈklɑːk, ˈpliːz.
